source_guard: Every native instruction within0x100000..0x110000, except stop-before-port-yield/mutex-provider entries. No fallback/helper result stubs.
limits: Real queue initialization/prefill are stock setup, not source completeness; invocation paths are native guarded.
Positive blocked calls execute timeout/event/list/suspend/resume providers and stop before actual port-yield; no exception dispatch or resumed blocking call.
ISR context is a synthetic architectural register profile, not actual IRQ entry/return; ICSR store is observed, not delivered.
Queue buffers valid/nonoverlapping; invalid direct-kernel handles, mutex disinherit and ISR overflow assertion not completed.
Every invocation is instruction-stepped without changing registers/instructions; continuous Unicorn produced a documented IT-state/return anomaly for aligned copies.
